The '''Corellian Colonizer''' was a class of [[Praxeum ship/Legends|praxeum ship]] that was used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Corellian Colonizers were considered the pride of the [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]], and at one point the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] operated thirteen of them. However, many were lost during the [[New Sith Wars]], and following the conflict, only three remained: the ''[[Beneficia]]'', the ''[[Luminosity]]'' and the ''[[Silikan Stillness]]''. The three surviving [[Starship/Legends|ships]] were used to carry out regular patrols of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the [[Rim Worlds]] and the edges of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].
